Verse of the Day
Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
Isaiah 5:20
Quote of the Day
"We don’t serve only those we already love; rather, we come to love people as we serve them."
Elder Gérald Caussé | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
